claim: In the matching retail DLL, PlayerController_AI.EndAIAct (0x06004FAD) and PlayerController_AI.EndPriAct (0x0600500B) form an exact teardown pair. EndAIAct is parameterless with an exact 33-byte body: it stores aiActDuration=0, stores aiAct=0, reads currentPriAct, and when currentPriAct is not raw -1 calls EndPriAct(), otherwise it returns directly. EndPriAct is parameterless with an exact 38-byte body: when keepLastSkill is zero it calls PlObj.SetLastSkill(-1); regardless of that branch it then stores keepLastSkill=0 and currentPriAct=-1 and returns. FACT-0014 pins a direct EndPriAct call from FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation under raw form flag mask 16, and the matching PlayerController_AI.Update body pins a direct EndAIAct call at IL+0x025D. FACT-0029 already closes Player.SetLastSkill, the callee used by EndPriAct.
